fichas.title: Detailed design (HOAI work phase 5)
fichas.summary: Describes the basic and special services for detailed design, including completing the design for construction, producing working drawings and coordinating specialist contributions. The phase also covers continued detailed design during construction.
uses: Prepare working drawings, details, and construction drawings

fichas.title: Means and instruments for construction design
fichas.summary: Explains construction drawings, detailed drawings, special drawings, and room schedules. Construction drawings show construction details and dimensions; detailed drawings supplement them for selected building sections. Room schedules record dimensions, materials, and equipment, and can support performance specifications and project administration.
uses: Supplement construction drawings for selected sections
Record room dimensions, materials, and equipment
Support tendering, contract award, and invoicing

fichas.title: Example short-form room schedule
fichas.summary: The example room schedule lists room use, area, height, and volume, alongside service connections, environmental values, and remarks. It includes a hall, bathroom/WC, kitchen, loggia, living/dining room, and service room.
uses: List heating, ventilation, sanitary, electrical, communications, and transport provisions
Record temperature, ventilation rate, lighting, and remarks
